title: Imam Saifi: first anniversary
titleOriginal: سلسل ادب قبلہ صحافت دار رہیا امام سیفی — پہلی برسی
takeaway: A sincere life of service keeps your name alive.
scene: Written for the first anniversary of the death of Imam Saifi, a respected journalist and writer. The poem lists the qualities that made him special.

original: خادم خیر الوریٰ دا مرد کامل آپ صحافت دار رہیا امام سیفی
عاشق رہبر سعادت دا عشق اندر منیا سب نے سیف اسلام سیفی
transliteration: Khaadim Khair-ul-Wara da, mard-e-kaamil, aap sahaafat-daar rehiya Imam Saifi
Aashiq rehbar-e-saadat da ishq andar, manniya sab ne Saif-e-Islam Saifi
translation: A servant of the Best of Creation, a complete man: Imam Saifi was a journalist.
In love with the guide to true happiness, everyone accepted Saifi as the 'sword of Islam'.
couplets.story: Imam Saifi devoted himself to the Prophet Muhammad, 'the best of creation'. He was a well-rounded, admirable man and a journalist. He loved the Prophet so much that people called him the 'sword of Islam'.

original: صادق صدق صفا دار رہیا پیکر علی حب دار رہیا غلام سیفی
الفت چاہت اتحاد خلوص والا دیندا قوم رہیا پیغام سیفی
transliteration: Saadiq, sidq safaa-daar rehiya, paikar-e-Ali, hubb-daar rehiya, ghulaam Saifi
Ulfat chaahat ittehaad khuloos vaala denda qaum rehiya paighaam Saifi
translation: Truthful, sincere and pure-hearted, he was like Ali himself, a loving, devoted servant.
Saifi kept giving the nation a message of affection, love, unity and sincerity.
couplets.story: He was honest and pure-hearted, and the poet compares his character to Ali, the Prophet's cousin. He kept telling people to love each other, stay united and be sincere.

original: قائد اعظم دا سجا سی ہتھ جویں کروے رہیں گے لوگ احترام سیفی
ایسے لئی میں احمدؔ آکھدا ہاں حشر تیک رہنا زندہ نام سیفی
transliteration: Quaid-e-Azam da sajja si hatth jiven, karde rehan ge log ehtiraam Saifi
Ise layi main Ahmad aakhda haan, hashr teek rehna zinda naam Saifi
translation: He was like Quaid-e-Azam's own right hand; people will go on respecting Saifi.
That's why I, Ahmad, say Saifi's name will live until Judgment Day.
couplets.story: He was as loyal to the cause as Jinnah's right-hand man. People will always respect him, and the poet says his name will be remembered until the end of time.

deeper: Saifi is praised mostly for his faith. He was a 'servant of the Best of Creation', meaning the Prophet, and loyal like Ali. The poem's idea is that a journalist's work can be a form of devotion. If you serve the truth and the people sincerely, that service is also serving God.
why: It shows how people of the poet's generation remembered each other: through devotion, service and unity.
prompt: What would you want people to remember you for a year after you're gone?
notes: The heading line is partly unclear; it is read as 'the pillar of literature and journalism, Imam Saifi'.
